name: MiniMind
summary: Project that trains a small ~64M-parameter language model from scratch, with the full pretrain-to-RL pipeline in PyTorch.
description: Minimal from-scratch LLM project: a 64M-parameter dense model (plus a 198M-A64M MoE variant) implemented in native PyTorch, together with the complete training pipeline — tokenizer training, pretrain, SFT, LoRA, RLHF (DPO), RLAIF (PPO/GRPO/CISPO), tool use, agentic RL, adaptive thinking and distillation. Ships open training datasets, an OpenAI-compatible API server, a Streamlit chat WebUI and single- or multi-GPU training scripts; the project doubles as a hands-on tutorial for understanding how LLMs work.
contains: 64M MiniMind-3 dense model and 198M-A64M MoE variant
pipeline covers pretrain, SFT, LoRA, RLHF-DPO, RLAIF (PPO/GRPO/CISPO) and distillation
open training datasets on ModelScope and HuggingFace
OpenAI-compatible API server and Streamlit chat WebUI
single- and multi-GPU (DDP, DeepSpeed) training with checkpoint resume
reported reproduction: one SFT epoch in ~2h on a single RTX 3090, ~¥3 GPU cost
